evidence: Keyboard focus indicator is difficult to distinguish while tabbing through navigation.
user_impact: Keyboard users may lose track of the active element.
recommended_fix: Add a high-contrast :focus outline for all interactive elements.

evidence: Input fields rely on placeholder text instead of persistent labels.
user_impact: Screen reader users may not understand required inputs.
recommended_fix: Associate visible <label> elements with every input using for/id.

evidence: Decorative and informative images are missing descriptive alt text.
user_impact: Screen reader users miss important context.
recommended_fix: Provide meaningful alt text and mark decorative images appropriately.

evidence: Some button text has insufficient contrast against the background.
user_impact: Low-vision users may struggle to read actions.
recommended_fix: Increase text/background contrast to meet WCAG AA.

evidence: Heading hierarchy skips levels, reducing document structure.
user_impact: Assistive technology users have a less predictable navigation experience.
